rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical competitive sport.

example.traditional: 足球係我最鍾意嘅運動。
example.jyutping: zuk1 kau4 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 wan6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for a person who takes teasing or losing cheerfully and is good-natured.

example.english: Ming is a real good sport; even when he loses, he can still joke about it.
example.traditional: 阿明真係好玩得嘅人，輸咗都仲識講笑。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 zan1 hai6 hou2 waan2 dak1 ge3 jan4 syu1 zo2 dou1 zung6 sik1 gong2 siu3

rows.note: Use this for the good-sportsmanship side of a person who can accept losing gracefully.

example.english: They do not get angry when they lose; they are really a good sport.
example.traditional: 佢輸咗都唔嬲，真係輸得起嘅人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 syu1 zo2 dou1 m4 nau1 zan1 hai6 syu1 dak1 hei2 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for the bad-sportsmanship side of a person who reacts badly to losing.

example.english: They throw a tantrum whenever they lose; they are really a bad sport.
example.traditional: 佢一輸就發脾氣，真係輸唔起嘅人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 syu1 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3 zan1 hai6 syu1 m4 hei2 ge3 jan4
